name: GB GF: Victoria
tagline: A fictional companion who reaches out around your day instead of at random
description: Most chat companions only exist while the window is open and you are typing. This one is written as a character with her own routine and a light, teasing register, and she reads your calendar before deciding when to say something. Context carries between conversations, so what you mentioned last week still lands.
author: AaronInfinitea
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
